INSTALL
No, I Already Have
IMPORTANT emSigner upgraded to Version 1.3.1 - install it and check your token before you log in or decrypt tenders. Download User Guide

IMPORTANT NOTICE - All Users: emSigner upgraded to Version 1.3.1

Dear users, As per the CCA Guidelines, the Digital Signature Token security standard has been upgraded from FIPS 140-2 to FIPS 140-3. Accordingly, the Telangana eProcurement emSigner has been upgraded from Version 1.3 to Version 1.3.1. Please complete the following steps before accessing the e-Tender application:

1Install emSigner Ver 1.3.1

Uninstall the old one (Control Panel -> Programs and Features), then install "emSigner Windows (OS) Setup File Ver 1.3.1 - NEW" from the Download section.

2Check token compatibility

Hyper Key: run "Test Hyper2003 Token OAEP Supported Check" (Download section) -> readOAEP: Y = compatible, N = not compatible.
Other tokens: insert token, click "Check Your DSC Token" on home page -> OAEP Supported: true = compatible, false = not compatible.
If N / false: contact your DSC token vendor for a compatible token.

3Repeated Token PIN requests

Open Hyper Token Driver -> Settings and enable Single Sign-On (SSO).

4WatchData Token users

Go to Quick Links -> Digital Signature and install the WatchData Token Driver.

5 Dashboard not loading after login (Firefox)

Open about:config in the address bar, accept the warning, search network.lna.websocket.enabled and set it to false.
